text:
maria: hey — running the node quickstart sample and my first call to /v1/generate is returning 403. error body says \"billing_required\". followed the README steps though. anyone seen this?

sam: can you paste the curl or the code you're using?

maria: sure:

```

export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xxx
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"billing_required\",\"message\":\"Workspace payment method required\"}

```

sam: ok yup that's a billing_required response. are you part of an org workspace with billing enabled or did you sign up via an invite link?

maria: I joined from an invite link sent by a teammate. I just clicked the link and logged in with Google. I didn't add a card.

oliver: @maria that flow can be subtle — invited users sometimes remain in a \"trial pending\" state until the org owner completes billing. the API will return 403 in that case. the web UI should show a banner.

maria: hmm interesting. the quickstart README actually uses a different env var name than the sample app. the README says set REDWOOD_TOKEN but the sample app reads REDWOOD_API_KEY. could that cause a 401 instead? I'm 403 though so not sure.

sam: good catch — env var mismatch would cause a 401/invalid-key, not billing_required. so two separate DX issues: (1) docs/env mismatch, (2) billing gating message not surfaced in quickstart.

devex-bot: Note: SDK retry policy currently retries on 5xx and network errors only. 4xx (401/403) are surfaced immediately. Filing a follow-up to improve guidance for billing_required errors.

maria: what's a quick unblock for me? can I create my own personal workspace and try?

oliver: yes — go to https://console.redwood.ai/account/workspaces and create a workspace (personal tier). add a payment method (free trial will be applied for new accounts). or run:

```
redwood-cli workspaces create --name \"maria-personal\"
redwood-cli workspaces link --id wrk_12345
```

sam: alternatively, if you have the org id ask the org owner to accept billing or add you as a guest with free access.

maria: ran the CLI link and re-ran the curl. now:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{\"output\":\"hello\"}
```

maria: works now :tada:

sam: awesome. I'll file two tickets: one to fix the README env var inconsistency, and one to make the SDK error message for billing_required include a direct link to the workspace billing page + a short remediation string.

devex-bot: Ticket created: DX-3421 (quickstart env var inconsistency) and DX-3422 (better billing_required UX in SDK).

maria: thanks all. leaving a quick note in the quickstart PR with the repro steps.

sam: thanks — appreciate the debugging notes :thumbsup:
